verdict.rationale: A state revenue agency could plausibly publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only portal-based filing, a 1099 XML upload format that follows IRS schemas, a 'For Tax Software Developers' heading, and a link to an external Open Data Portal business-license search. None of these amount to published API endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits on the agency's own pages. All OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404.
